originalTitle: Trump says he still has confidence in Fed Chair Warsh, demands 1% or lower interest rates
summary: President Donald Trump previously threatened to cut off trade with countries that have trade surpluses with the U.S. if the Fed doesn't cut interest rates.
content:
President Donald Trump said Wednesday he still has confidence in Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh , but also said he wants the central bank to slash interest rates to 1% "or less."

Trump's comments came hours after the central bank announced its first rate hike since 2023.

Warsh, who was nominated by Trump as Fed chair, had defended Wednesday's widely expected rate increase of 25 basis points as appropriate.

The decision by the 12-member Federal Open Market Committee to raise benchmark interest rates to a target range of 3.75% to 4% was unanimous.

"I do," Trump told reporters when asked after arriving on a campaign trip to North Carolina if he still had confidence in Warsh.

"I'm relying on Kevin, but he's got, you know, a very tough board, he's got a board that was put there by other people," Trump said. "And I told, I talked to Kevin, and I said, 'You might as well vote with the board. It's not going to matter.'"

Trump's remarks may undercut his and Warsh's promises that the Fed has independence from the White House.

"The board is very hostile. They're very political. They're doing the wrong thing," Trump said.

"They're raising the rates to make Trump do as bad as they can possibly can do," the president said before heading to a campaign event for Republican Senate candidate Michael Whatley.

But asked if he believed Warsh made a decision based on what Trump told him, the president replied, "No, I don't think so."

"I want him to be independent, he said.

Earlier Wednesday and after the Fed's rate decision, Trump, in a Truth Social post , demanded the Fed lower interest rates.

"We are 'carrying' almost every country in the World, and that cannot go on any longer," Trump wrote.

"LOWER THE INTEREST RATES FOR THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, AND FAST!" he wrote.

The FOMC, in a statement after the rate hike, said, "Inflation remains elevated."

Updated projections released Wednesday show a strong majority of Fed officials expect another rate increase could be on the way.

But Trump, who has relentlessly pressured the Fed to drastically lower borrowing costs, insisted in his Truth post that rates in the U.S. "should be 1%, or less, because we are the Best Credit in the World — BY FAR."

"Our Country is BOOMING with new Investment!" wrote Trump, who has repeatedly claimed that the U.S. has raked in as much as $20 trillion or more during his second term. Fact-checkers say Trump's figures are false , and the White House on Sept. 9 said, "President Trump has secured more than $11 trillion in new U.S. investment."

"If we stopped Trading with every country that we have a Deficit with, which is most of them, we would make, at least, 1.5 Trillion Dollars a year," Trump claimed in Wednesday's post.

Less than two weeks earlier, Trump threatened that if the Fed doesn't cut rates, he will cut off trade with countries that have trade surpluses with the U.S. That group includes most of the U.S.'s top trading partners , along with dozens of other countries.

That extreme threat poured gasoline on Trump's years-long pressure campaign against the Fed, which had temporarily subsided after Warsh succeeded Jerome Powell as chairman.

So far, however, Trump and his aides have refrained from attacking Warsh directly.

White House spokesman Kush Desai told Fox News earlier Wednesday afternoon that Trump "absolutely" still believes in the independence of the Fed.

"But that doesn't change the fact that the president of the United States has a First Amendment right" to speak out "when things go awry," Desai added.
chineseTitle: 特朗普表示对美联储主席沃什仍有信心，要求1%或更低的利率
chineseSummary: 唐纳德·特朗普总统此前威胁称，如果美联储不降息，他将切断与美国有贸易顺差的国家的贸易。
chineseContent:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周三表示，他仍然对美联储主席凯文·沃什充满信心，但也表示他希望美联储将利率削减至“1%或更低”。

特朗普发表此番言论的几个小时前，央行宣布自 2023 年以来首次加息。

被特朗普提名为美联储主席的沃什为周三普遍预期的加息 25 个基点进行了适当的辩护。

联邦公开市场委员会12名成员一致决定将基准利率提高至3.75%至4%的目标区间。

“我愿意，”特朗普在抵达北卡罗来纳州竞选之旅后被问及他是否仍然对沃什有信心时告诉记者。

特朗普说：“我依靠凯文，但他有一个非常强硬的董事会，他有一个由其他人设立的董事会。” “我告诉凯文，我说，‘你不妨和董事会一起投票。这并不重要。’”

特朗普的言论可能会削弱他和沃什关于美联储独立于白宫的承诺。

“董事会非常敌对。他们非常政治化。他们做错了事，”特朗普说。

“他们提高利率是为了让特朗普做得尽可能糟糕，”总统在前往共和党参议院候选人迈克尔·沃特利的竞选活动之前说道。

但当被问及他是否相信沃什根据特朗普告诉他的内容做出决定时，总统回答说：“不，我不这么认为。”

“我希望他独立，”他说。

周三早些时候，在美联储做出利率决定后，特朗普在《真相社会》帖子中要求美联储降低利率。

特朗普写道：“我们正在‘承受’世界上几乎每个国家，这种情况不能再继续下去了。”

“降低美国的利率，而且要快！”他写道。

联邦公开市场委员会(FOMC)在加息后的一份声明中表示，“通胀仍然处于高位”。

周三发布的最新预测显示，绝大多数美联储官员预计可能会再次加息。

但特朗普一直不断向美联储施压，要求其大幅降低借贷成本，他在《真相》帖子中坚称，美国的利率“应该为 1% 或更低，因为我们是迄今为止世界上最好的信贷机构”。

“我们的国家正在通过新的投资而蓬勃发展！”特朗普写道，他一再声称美国在他的第二个任期内获得了高达 20 万亿美元或更多的收入。事实核查人员称特朗普的数据是虚假的，白宫9月9日表示，“特朗普总统已获得超过11万亿美元的美国新投资”。

特朗普在周三的帖子中声称，“如果我们停止与每个有赤字的国家（其中大部分国家）进行贸易，我们每年至少会赚到 1.5 万亿美元。”

不到两周前，特朗普威胁称，如果美联储不降息，他将切断与对美国有贸易顺差的国家的贸易。该群体包括美国的大多数主要贸易伙伴以及其他数十个国家。

这种极端威胁为特朗普多年来对美联储的施压行动注入了动力，而在沃什接替杰罗姆·鲍威尔担任主席后，这种压力暂时平息了。

然而到目前为止，特朗普和他的助手们还没有直接攻击沃什。

白宫发言人库什·德赛周三下午早些时候告诉福克斯新闻，特朗普“绝对”仍然相信美联储的独立性。

德赛补充说，“但这并不能改变这样一个事实，即美国总统拥有第一修正案的权利”，“在事情出现问题时”发声。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
